content: Zerethi Zeriya Ura Leemiso
He gallas Yesuusi soope keyidi abba gaxan uttis.
Daro derey iya yuushuwan shiiqin asaa abba gaxan aggaagidi wogolon gelidi uttis.
Asaas darobaa leemison yaagidi odis: “Issi goshshanchoy zerethi zeranaw keyis.
I zeriya wode issi issi zerethati oge gaxan wodhidosona; entaka kafoti yidi maxi midosona.
Issi issi zerethati garsan shaalloy de7iya biitta bolla wodhidosona. Daro biitti bayna gisho ellesidi dolis.
Shin away keyin shullis; xaphoy bayna gisho melis.
Issi issi zerethay aguntha giddon wodhis; agunthay diccidi he dolaa cuullis.
Harati qassi aradda biitta bolla wodhis; dolidi ayfe ayfis. Issoy xeeta, issoy usupun tamma, issoy qassi hastama ayfis.
Si7iya haythi de7iya uray si7o” yaagis.
Yesuusa tamaareti iyako shiiqidi, “Ayis neeni deriyas leemison oday?” yaagidi oychidosona.
I zaaridi, “Hintew salo kawotethaa xuuraa eray imetis, shin entaw imetibeenna.
De7iya ubbaas guzhetana, iyaw darana, shin baynaysafe hari attoshin iyaw de7iyaraka eketana.
Hessa gisho, taani enti, xeellishe demmonna mela, si7ishe si7onna mela woyko akeekona mela entaw leemison odayis.
“Isayaasi ba maxaafan odidaysi enta bolla poletis. I odishe,

content.text: Ayis giiko, ha asaa wozanay zel7umis;
Hessi bayneko enti banta ayfiyan be7idi,

content: “Shin hinte ayfeti be7iya gishonne hinte haythati si7iya gisho hinte anjetidaysata.
Ta hintew tuma odayis; daro nabetinne xilloti hinte be7eysa be7anawunne hinte si7eysa si7anaw amotidosona, shin entaw hanibeenna.
“Hiza, ha zerethi zeriya uraa leemisuwa si7ite.
Oge gaxan wodhida zerethi leemisoy haysa: salo kawotethaa qaala si7idi akeekona uraa wozanape Xalahey yidi iya wozanan de7iya zeretha maxi diggees.
Shaalloy garsan de7iya biitta bolla zeretidaysi qaala si7idi ellesidi ufaysan ekeyisata.
Shin xapho yeddanaw danda7onna gisho daro gam7okona. Qaala gaason metoy woyko goodetethi yaa wode ellesi dhubetoosona.
Aguntha gaathan zeretidaysi qaala si7is, shin ha alamiya duussaa Hirgaynne duretetha qofay qaala cuulliya gisho ayfe ayfonna attees.
Shin aradda biittan zeretida zerethay akeekan qaala si7iya uraa. I ayfe ayfees; issoy xeeta, issoy usupun tamma issoy qassi hastama ayfees” yaagis.
Leeshsho Leemiso
Yesuusi entaw hara leemiso odis, “Xoossaa kawotethay ba goshshan lo77o zerethi zerida uraa daanees.
Shin asi ubbay dhiskin iya morkey yidi gistiya giddon leeshsho zeridi bis.
Gistey diccidi ayfiya wode leeshshoy iya giddon bentis.
“Gadiya godaa aylleti godaako bidi, ‘Godaw, ne goshshan ne lo77o zerethi zerabikisho? Yaatin, leeshshoy awupe yidee?’ yaagidosona.
“I entako, ‘Hessa morkey oothis’ yaagis. “Aylleti godaako, ‘Nu bidi leeshuwa shoddana mela koyay?’ yaagidosona.
“Shin I, ‘Atto bochofite; hinte leeshuwa shoddayis gishin gistey shodetana.
Bochofite; caka wodey gakanaw issife dicco. He wode cakiya asata leeshuwa sinthatidi maxidi taman xuugganaw mirqen mirqen qachite. Shin gistiya shiishidi ta shaaliyan qolite’ yaagana” yaagis.
Ayfe Guutha Mithee Leemiso
Qassi hara leemiso yaagidi odis; “Salo kawotethay issi asi ba goshshan bakida guutha mithee ayfe daanees.
He mithee ayfey hara mitha ayfetape guutha, shin iya dolaa diccida hara mithata ubbaafe aadhada gitatawusu. I tashiyan kafoti keexidi uttana gakanaw wolqaama mithi gidawusu” yaagis.
Irsho Leemiso
Kaallidika, Yesuusi hara leemiso odis; “Salo kawotethay issi maccasi heedzu gabate dhiille eka munuqada, munuqay dendana mela iyan gujida irsho daanees” yaagis.
Yesuusi deriyas he leemisuwa ubbaa odis. Leemisoy bayna issibaaka odibeenna.
Nabey ba maxaafan,
yaagidi odidaysi hessan poletis.
Leeshsho Leemiso Birshetha
Yesuusi deriya moyzidi soo gelis. Iya tamaareti iyako shiiqidi, “Goshshan de7iya leeshuwa birshethaa nuus oda” yaagidosona.
I zaaridi, “Lo77o zerethi zeriday Asa Na7a.
Goshshay ha alamiya. Lo77o zerethay salo kawotethaa nayta. Leeshshoy Xalahe nayta.
Leeshuwa zeriday morkiya Xalahe. Caka wodey, wode wursethi; cakeysati kiitanchota.
“Leeshshoy maxetidi taman xuugeteysa mela wodiya wursethan hessada hanana.
Asa Na7ay ba kiitanchota kiittana. Enti nagaras gaaso gideysatanne iita oothiya ubbaa maxidi iya kawotethaafe kessana.
Maxi shiishidi yeehoynne acha garcethi de7iya to7onna taman yeggana.
He wode xilloti banta Aawa kawotethan awada poo7ana. Si7iya haythi de7ey si7o!
“Xoossaa kawotethay goshshan moogetida miishe daanees. Issi asi he miishiya demmidi zaari moogis. Daro ufaytidi bidi baw de7iyaba ubbaa bayzidi he goshsha gadiya shammis.
“Hessadaka, qassi salo kawotethay inqu geetetiya al7o shuchata koyiya zal7ancho daanees.
Daro al7o inquwa demmidi bidi baw de7iyaba ubbaa bayzidi iya shammis.
Molo Oykiya Gite Leemiso
“Qassi Xoossaa kawotethay abban yegetida dumma dumma qommo molo oykiya gitiya daanees.
Molo oykiya asati moloy gitiyan kumin abbaafe gaxa kessidosona. Yan uttidi lo77uwa qori qori daachon yeggidosona, shin iita molota wora holidosona.
Wodiya wursethan hessatho hanana. Kiitanchoti yidi nagaranchota xillotape shaakidi,
yeehoynne acha garcethi de7iya to7onna taman yeggana.
“Ha ubbay hintew gelidee?” yaagidi enta oychis. Enti zaaridi, “Ee” yaagidosona.
Yesuusi, “Hiza, salo kawotethaa eraa ekidi higgiya tamaarsiya ubbay, ba minjida shaluwape oorathaanne gal7a kessiya ase daanees” yaagis.
Yesuusi Naazireten Ixetis
Yesuusi ha leemisuwa odi wursidaape guye yaape dendidi bis.
Ba yeletida biitta bidi ayhude woosa keethan deriya tamaarsis. Enti malaaletidi, “Ha uray ha cincatethaanne ha malaatata oothiya wolqaa awupe ekidee?
Haysi anaaxiya na7aa gidenneyee? Iya aaye sunthay Mayraamo gidennee? Iya ishati Yayqooba, Yoosefa, Simoonanne Yihuda gidokonaayee?
Iya micheti nuura de7oosona gidokona? Yaatin, ha uray ha ubbaa awupe ekidee?” yaagidosona.
Hessa gisho, I giyaba ekonna ixidosona. Shin Yesuusi, “Nabey ba yeletida biittaninne ba soo asaa matan bonchetenna” yaagis.
Enti ammanonna ixida gisho daro malaatata he bessan oothibeenna.
